description_zh: 修改已存在的巡检配置
kebab_example: aliyun rdsai modify-scheduled-task --scheduled-id 847268a4-196f-416b-aa12-bfe0c1150000 --name 'RDS巡检任务' --description '定时RDS实例巡检任务' --instance-ids rm-2ze6mk259v3220000,rm-2zef3b65430j00000 --start-time 02:00:00Z --frequency Monday --time-range 24 --report-language example-string --inspection-items example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyScheduledTask

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scheduled inspection configuration
parameters.name: scheduled_id

parameters.help_en: The new name of the inspection configuration
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The new description of the inspection configuration
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The new list of associated instance IDs. Separate multiple values with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 新的实例关联列表, 多个取值用英文逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: instance_ids

parameters.help_en: The new time to execute the inspection task. Format: HH:mm:ssZ (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 新的执行巡检任务的时间。格式：HH:mm:ssZ（UTC 时间）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The new inspection frequency. Separate multiple values with commas (,). Default value: DAILY. Valid values:
DAILY: every day
Monday: Monday
Tuesday: Tuesday
Wednesday: Wednesday
Thursday: Thursday
Friday: Friday
Saturday: Saturday
Sunday: Sunday
Note: DAILY overrides weekly values. For example, if you specify DAILY,Monday, the backend uses DAILY as the inspection frequency
parameters.help_zh:
新的巡检频率，多个取值用英文逗号（,）隔开，默认为DAILY。取值：
DAILY：每天
Monday：周一
Tuesday：周二
Wednesday：周三
Thursday：周四
Friday：周五
Saturday：周六
Sunday：周日
注意：DAILY会覆盖周时间，例如填写DAILY,Monday后端会取DAILY作为巡检频率
parameters.name: frequency

parameters.help_en: The inspection time range. Default value: the last 24 hours. Valid values: 1 to 168 (up to 7 days)
parameters.help_zh: 巡检时间范围，默认最近24小时，取值：1~168（最大支持7天）
parameters.name: time_range
